ui.workspace_footer: Each workspace holds the tabs for one stage of an analysis
search.keys: Enter starts the lit command     Esc closes
search.command_keys: Enter runs the command as typed     Esc closes

ui.view_compass_tip_snap: Look from {axis}; click again to look from the other side, drag to orbit, hold Shift to snap

settings.title: Settings
settings.restore_defaults_hint: Put this page's settings back as a new install has them
settings.units_display_hint: Numbers are shown and typed in these units; a model can keep its own (Model › Units). Models are stored in SI, so nothing in them changes.
settings.history_dock_hint: Where the History bar stands over the view; drag its grip to move it to the other edge.
settings.usage_share_hint: Help improve FieldCraft: which tools you use, nothing from your models.
settings.usage_automation_hint: Count the commands that scripts, the control channel and AI agents run, apart from yours.
settings.usage_unavailable: This build or run sends nothing: it has no analytics key, or FIELDCRAFT_TELEMETRY=0, CI or automation turned it off.
settings.usage_detail: Counted: the commands you run (their names, how long they took, whether they failed), the steps from a design to results, the samples you open, and the version, OS and a random id for this install. Never sent: file names or paths, geometry, model contents, parameter values or messages.
settings.usage_local: Crash reports and the log stay on this computer; Help › Report a Bug sends only what you submit.
settings.usage_what_is_sent_hint: Open the privacy page, event by event, in the browser.
settings.updates_automatic_hint: At start-up, at most once a day, FieldCraft asks GitHub Releases for the latest version. Nothing installs until you choose Install.
settings.updates_request: The check sends only the request (your IP address and the FieldCraft version reach GitHub); off means no check.
settings.updates_now_hint: Ask GitHub Releases for the latest version now.
settings.updates_skipped_hint: The automatic check does not offer this version.
settings.updates_unavailable: This build does not check for updates.
settings.general_note: How numbers are shown, and where the window's bars and cards stand.
settings.privacy_note: What FieldCraft may send to help improve it.
settings.updates_note: Whether FieldCraft looks for a newer version, and the one it skips.
settings.browser_float_hint: Show the view through the browser card
settings.browser_eye_left_hint: Show each browser row's visibility eye before its icon, not at the row's end
settings.status_bar_hint: Show the model's size, the projection and the graphics device along the window's bottom
settings.updates_skipped_none: No version is skipped. Skip, on the notice that offers an update, skips that version.
